description: Search The Wiley Rule's registry of companies, associations and people named in government and court records tied to 7-OH and kratom, illegal disposable vapes, hemp-derived intoxicants, tianeptine and nitazenes (FDA warning letters and import alerts, DOJ/DEA cases, state attorney general actions, USITC, a U.S. Senate report, SEC, lobbying and FEC filings). Each record carries a plain label such as 'Named on FDA import alert', 'Warning letter', 'Indicted (allegation)' or 'Convicted/sentenced'. An import alert, warning letter, complaint or indictment is not a finding of guilt; always pass the label along with the name.

agency.description: Issuing agency, e.g. FDA, DOJ, Missouri Attorney General

query.description: Name, brand, place or words in the record, e.g. 'Elf Bar', 'Missouri', 'tianeptine'

name: search_actors
title: Who's behind it: companies, groups and people in the public record
